---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Which part of the project does this touch?

Tick anything that applies:

- [ ] Video search / scraping (sources, queries, pagination)
- [ ] Ranking / ML scoring
- [ ] Voice assistant
- [ ] Song renderer (`song_service/`)
- [ ] Web UI (`public/index.html`)
- [ ] Worker / deployment (`worker.js`, `wrangler.toml`)
- [ ] Build, tooling or measurement scripts (`build/`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other / not sure

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## How would you know it works?

What could be measured or checked to show the feature does what it should? If it changes audio,
ranking or search output, say which number or file you would compare.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, links or examples about the feature request here.
